content.short: Kriya is a Sui-based orderbook decentralized exchange offering swaps, limit orders, and vault-based investment strategies.
content.description: Kriya is a Sui-based orderbook decentralized exchange built to serve the Sui network. It currently supports swaps and limit orders and offers vault-based investment strategies. The project is gearing up to introduce perpetual contracts on Sui, an upcoming feature that has generated significant interest across the ecosystem. By delivering an on-chain orderbook experience and flexible yield strategies, Kriya aims to become the leading DeFi presence on Sui and to broaden its offerings for traders and investors.
